description: 20 legitimate names that are not aliases of the known baseline and should not be reported as typosquats. Several are ecosystem-adjacent hard negatives. One (cordis-http-client) is a plausible official plugin name that the generic 'cordis' entry causes to be reported as a low-score extra segment.

legit.name: @acme/widget-kit
legit.rationale: scoped variant is a distinct package, not an alias

legit.name: cascade-router
legit.rationale: same generic suffix as orbit-router, but a distinct package

legit.name: dsh-catalog
legit.rationale: plausible dsh- package whose core token is far from every known dsh- name

legit.name: cordis-http-client
legit.rationale: plausible Cordis ecosystem extension; hard negative that the extra-segment heuristic reports as low severity
